rv.q: They take a strictly trad approach to their solid b-boying, styling a battle as though they were two computer game avatars. Later, Sette offers some moves “for the mums” and Graham presents an impressive turn on a mini Cyr wheel. But there’s not a tremendous sense of dynamism to the stop-start structure, and the tricks are largely jeopardy-free.
360 Allstars is a love letter to hip-hop, a perfect family show that is concise and charming.
